# OKCompressor / OKC

OKC builds reversible structural systems, model-facing transforms, interoperability layers and reproducible research artifacts.

## Current public surfaces

- / — DUMBer V1G / DU3 structural baseline and benchmark surface
- /lab/nereids/ — Nereids exact structural interoperability / Phase 3 1GB receipt
- /projects/rare1.html — Rare1 optional long-tail transform
- /products/zrank.html — zRank optional model transform
- /licensing.html — LNCL 1.2 licensing boundary
- /contact.html — inquiry / integration routes

## Nereids

Nereids separates canonical byte identity from tokenizer segmentation.

Current demonstrated Phase 3 path:

bytes
→ DU3 structural representation
→ canonical DU lexeme bytes
→ precomputed DU GID to target-ID mapping
→ cl100k_base mergeable IDs
→ exact original bytes

1GB enwik9 Phase 3:
- 1,000,000,000 input bytes
- 0 unmappable DU entries
- exact raw / DU / target reconstruction
- source: https://github.com/OKCompressor/nereids
- receipt: https://github.com/OKCompressor/nereids/blob/main/docs/benchmarks/enwik9-phase3-20260911.md

Nereids does not currently claim canonical cl100k BPE segmentation equality, universal tokenizer equivalence, KV portability or learned-state exactness.

## DU3

Public module alpha release:
https://github.com/OKCompressor/core/releases/tag/modules-alpha-20260911

DU3 structural reduction and final entropy-coded compression are separate measurement boundaries.

## Licensing

Canonical LNCL 1.2:
https://github.com/OKCompressor/core/blob/main/docs/LICENSE.md

A release may be Source-Available or Binary-Only according to its declared release mode.

Nereids is currently Source-Available under LNCL 1.2.

LNCL is not represented as OSI open source.

## Public discipline

Receipts before claims.
Exact boundaries must remain explicit.
Structural reduction, model representation size, entropy-coded size, wall time and RSS are separate dimensions.
